acroyoga.title: Acroyoga
acroyoga.intro: Acroyoga blends acrobatics and yoga. It's usually practiced in pairs: together, you build balancing poses based on trust and attentiveness.

base.name: The base
base.description: Lying on the ground, the base supports and balances the flyer, usually with their feet and hands.

flyer.name: The flyer
flyer.description: Lifted by the base, the flyer takes the poses in the air and lets themselves be guided while staying engaged.

spotter.name: The spotter
spotter.description: The spotter keeps everyone safe, helps with balance and prevents falls.

acroyoga.benefits: A discipline that builds strength, balance and flexibility, as well as communication and letting go.
